notes.content:

- Gamepad adjustments.
- Some hint text adjustments.
- Fixed: Some issues when throwing a sheep into the river.
- Fixed: Panel canvas error during sheep mounting.

- [Community Suggestion] Changed sprint button to toggle on gamepad. 
- Added mount tutorial video.

- Gamepad adjustments.

- Level design adjustments.

- Added "(Hold)" to shield statue's text.

- Fixed: Sheep checkpoint UI issue.
